name: gramstax
description: Page-based routing and a template system for Telegram bots.

prompts.prompt: How do I add a page and turn it into a route?
Which deploy mode should I use?
How do I write a template and render it?

instructions: Target gramstax v6. For v5 code, read the migrating-to-6 guide before touching any render method.
Treat a file path under src/pages as its route: src/pages/admin/ban.ts handles the admin/ban route.
Register a handler by naming a handle* method on the page class. There is no route table and no bot.command(...) registration.

Write templates as HTML-like files. Use g-* PAGE blocks for the message body, keyboards and media, and the 54 Telegram rich-HTML tags for content. The block vocabulary is closed: g-script is rejected at build time, so keep logic in the page class and return plain data.
Call renderText({...}) and its siblings instead of sendMessage. Render params are a union over delivery routes, so pass only the keys your winning route reads.
Treat the API reference section as generated from the package TypeScript declarations. Cite it for signatures and types, and prefer the guides and concepts pages for prose and recommendations.
